title: Project Context Primitive
description: Defines what 'knowing the project' means. Prompts read this to understand what structured context exists before acting. Replaces ad-hoc git log, ls, find AGENTS.md commands.

versionControl.description: Recent commit history for understanding active work streams.
versionControl.outputShape: array of { hash: string, message: string }

conventions.outputShape: object with keys: conventions, constraints, patterns, glossary (if CONTEXT.md present)

dependencies.description: Package manifest for understanding available libraries.
dependencies.outputShape: object with keys: runtime, devDependencies, language, toolchain

queryProtocol.description: How an agent queries project context. Always use this structured approach, never raw shell commands.
steps: 1. Read nearest AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md for conventions
2. Read version control context (recent commits, active branches)
4. Read directory structure for module boundaries
5. Compose a ProjectContext object from all sources

glossaryRefs.description: Paths to CONTEXT.md or UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md files found
